boundary.zh: PostHog 官方托管实例公开的完整 Public API schema；不按 Explinks 的数据仓库子集裁剪。
boundary.en: The complete Public API schema exposed by an official PostHog hosted instance, not the narrower data-warehouse subset shown by Explinks.

blockers.zh: metadata 已升级到已发布的 typed SSE spec 版本，但官方 schema 中实际 stream 路由仍仅以 string 表示响应；固定的 MIT 源码已补充重连、保活和终止行为，尚无可审核的完整业务事件联合及每个事件的 Schema。
blockers.en: Metadata now uses the released typed-SSE spec version, but the official schema still represents its actual stream routes only as strings. Pinned MIT source adds reconnect, keepalive, and termination behavior, but an auditable complete business-event union and schema for every event are still missing.

blockers.zh: 独立 SDK 和介绍并非因 ee/ 企业许可证而当然不可发布：官方 posthog.com 仓库对 contents/ 文档内容授予 MIT 权利，根仓库的 MIT 适用于非 ee/ 内容。但托管 schema 本身未声明许可证；必须逐项记录所用文档/源码出处，不复制 ee/、未授权 schema payload 或受限品牌资产。
blockers.en: The ee/ Enterprise License does not by itself forbid an independently authored SDK or API introduction: the official posthog.com repository grants MIT rights for documentation under contents/, while the root repository's MIT license applies outside ee/. The hosted schema itself is unlicensed, so every reused fact or prose node still needs provenance; no ee/ code, unlicensed schema payload, or restricted brand asset may be copied.

blockers.zh: 当前契约来自官方托管实例的可变 schema URL，未固定到可复现的 Git revision；官方 MIT 文档源只覆盖完整 schema 的一小部分 Endpoint。不能把托管 payload 原样入库，必须以可许可的一手文档/源码逐项独立重建并证明完整性。
blockers.en: The current contract comes from a mutable official hosted-schema URL rather than a reproducible Git revision, while the official MIT documentation source covers only a small subset of its endpoints. The hosted payload cannot be vendored; a complete contract must be independently reconstructed from permitted first-party documentation/source and have coverage evidence.

nextAction.zh: 建立 Endpoint/Schema/SSE 的逐项来源与覆盖矩阵：优先使用 MIT 的 contents/ 文档和非 ee/ MIT 源码，托管 schema 仅用于差异观测；升级并验证已发布 typed SSE 契约能力，随后完成敏感读取/写入策略、双语 PontxSpec 与 SDK/CLI 发布链路。
nextAction.en: Build an endpoint/schema/SSE provenance-and-coverage matrix: prefer MIT-licensed contents/ documentation and non-ee/ MIT source, using the hosted schema only for drift observation; adopt and validate a released typed-SSE contract, then complete sensitive read/write policy, bilingual PontxSpec, and the SDK/CLI release chain.
